remarks: LOVELY SUN-FILLED PRIVATE RIVERFRONT END TOWNHOUSE at desirable Canaan Close offers spectacular views of the Five Mile River and all its tranquility. This is the lifestyle you've been waiting for. Set on 7 serene acres of lush green property, this complex is known for its extensive landscaping, private gardens and meandering walking paths. This updated 3-4 bedrooms, 2.5 bath townhouse offers a mid century vibe, sunny living spaces and floating staircases that lead to spacious bedrooms with walk-in closets. There is a finished full walk-out lower level (an additional 1175 sq ft), leading to a second deck and courtyard overlooking the river. The uniquely sited river-front swimming pool overlooks a natural waterfall and offers expansive decks shaded by mature maple trees. This is a rare opportunity for a low maintenance lifestyle, without sacrificing space, privacy, or serenity, and all within walking distance to the train and downtown New Canaan. This is quite the find! *Parking garage is down a short path off of same level as front stoop (see map on dining table at townhouse). See agent remarks regarding offers.
